title: Saving & Exporting
description: Autosave to the gallery, a real file of your own, and exports other programs can use.

bubble.title: Three different things
bubble.body: Autosave keeps your work safe in this browser. A saved file is yours to keep anywhere. An export is a picture of the drawing for other programs.

bubble.title: The gallery autosaves
bubble.body: File → Open Document shows the gallery: every document saved in this browser, with the current one autosaved as you work. Naming a document (in Document Info) is what files it properly.

bubble.title: Save to File keeps it anywhere
bubble.body: File → Save to File downloads a NibGlider document file — the drawing in NibGlider's own format, layers and all. Keep it, back it up, send it.

bubble.title: Open File brings it back
bubble.body: File → Open File, or dropping the file onto the canvas, reopens a saved document exactly as it was. Older gallery documents keep working too.

bubble.title: Export for other programs
bubble.body: File → Export gives PNG or JPG pictures, or SVG and PDF vector files — of the whole document, the current view, or just the selection. An Export Frame pins an exact size for repeat exports.
